info.title: Caseward
info.description: Caseward browser API. Send Accept: application/json and include cookies. First GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie, then send the URL-decoded XSRF-TOKEN cookie as X-XSRF-TOKEN on writes. Refresh that cookie after session changes. Unverified accounts can access /api/session and verification routes; workspace routes and /api/user require a verified email. Frontend-origin requests must match the configured Sanctum stateful domains.
